subject: Film & Cinema
title: Winsor McCay: Animation's First Genius
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Winsor McCay: Animation's First Genius.

hook.text: McCay drew 10,000 frames by hand to animate a dinosaur. The audience thought it was alive.

buildup.text: Gertie the Dinosaur in 1914 was the first animated character with a recognizable personality.

discovery.text: McCay performed live alongside his animation, interacting with Gertie on stage.

twist.text: Studios soon industrialized animation, replacing lone geniuses with assembly-line production.

climax.text: McCay proved animation could create characters audiences cared about, not just moving shapes.

punchline.text: He drew a dinosaur and gave it a soul.

quiz.question: Why was Gertie the Dinosaur groundbreaking?
options: It was the first animated character with a distinct personality
